 import io
 from tempfile import SpooledTemporaryFile
-from typing import BinaryIO
+from typing import Any, BinaryIO
 
 import pytest
 
@@ -359,6 +359,30 @@ async def test_uploadfile_rolling(max_size: int) -> None:
     await file.close()
 
 
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_uploadfile_rolling_write_uses_threadpool(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    stream: BinaryIO = SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=4)  # type: ignore[assignment]
+    file = UploadFile(filename="file", file=stream, size=0)
+    threadpool_calls: list[bytes] = []
+
+    async def run_in_threadpool(func: Any, data: bytes) -> None:
+        threadpool_calls.append(data)
+        func(data)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("starlette.datastructures.run_in_threadpool", run_in_threadpool)
+
+    try:
+        await file.write(b"data")
+        assert threadpool_calls == []
+        assert not getattr(stream, "_rolled")
+
+        await file.write(b" more")
+        assert threadpool_calls == [b" more"]
+        assert getattr(stream, "_rolled")
+    finally:
+        stream.close()
+
+
